:::{#def-training-set}
#### Training set

A **training set** is the data
to which a [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure) is applied:
$\nobs$ observations,
written as an ordered list indexed by a set $\obsidx$ of $\nobs$ observation numbers:

$$
\trainset \eqdef \paren{(\vpredvar_{\iobs}, \outvar_{\iobs})}_{\iobs \in \obsidx}, \quad \abs{\obsidx} = \nobs.
$$ {#eq-training-set}

:::

:::{#rem-source-training-set}
#### Source: Training set

@hastie2009elements [sec. 7.2], who also write the training set as $\mathcal{T}$.

:::
